brief_title: Examination of How the Duration of Fasting and Temporary Stopping of Zenagamtide Dosing Affect the Amount of Food Left in the Stomach in Adults With Overweight or Obesity, With or Without Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Investigation of the Effect of Fasting Duration and Temporary Withholding of Subcutaneous Administration of Zenagamtide on Retained Gastric Contents in Participants With Overweight or Obesity, With or Without Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: Occurrence of empty stomach (antrum grade 0 or 1) after fasting following a solid, high-fat meal 1 day after dosing of s.c. zenagamtide once weekly (Yes/No)
primary_outcomes.time_frame: 6, 8, 10, 12, 18 and 24 hours after start of fasting on visit 2 day 1 (V2D-1) and V19D2

brief_summary: The purpose of this clinical study is to find out how the duration of fasting (not eating or drinking, except for water) and pausing of treatment with zenagamtide medication affect the amount of food and liquid left in the stomach of people using zenagamtide.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female (sex assigned at birth, inclusive of all gender identities).
* Age 18 and older at the time of signing the informed consent.
* Considered eligible based on the medical history, physical examination, and the results of vital signs, electrocardiogram (ECG) and clinical laboratory tests performed during the screening visit, as judged by the investigator.

For participants with type 2 diabetes (T2D)

* Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes (T2D) more than (\>) 180 days before screening.
* No treatment with oral anti-diabetic drugs except metformin. Treatment with metformin should be stable (dose and dosing frequency) for at least 90 days before screening.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known or suspected hypersensitivity to study intervention(s) or related products.
* Female who is pregnant, breast-feeding or intends to become pregnant or is of childbearing potential and not using adequate contraceptive method.
* Presence of clinically significant gastrointestinal disorders or symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders as judged by the investigator.
* Diagnosed with or suspected to suffer from gastroparesis, hiatal hernia or severe gastro-oesophageal reflux diseases with daily symptoms and/or when in supine position.
* Use of other medications known to affect the motility of the stomach.
* Inability to lie in the right lateral decubitus position for gastric ultrasonography.

For participants without T2D - Glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) more than or equal to (≥) 6.5 percent (%) \[48 millimoles per mole (mmol/mol)\] at screening.

For participants with T2D

\- HbA1c ≥ 10.5 % (91 mmol/mol) at screening.
